# Config Reference

## Precedence

| Layer                                              | Description                                                              |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| built-in defaults                                  | Built-in defaults from internal/config/defaults.go                       |
| $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/config.toml                     | Home config.toml overrides built-ins                                     |
| project .billyharness/config.toml                  | Nearest project .billyharness/config.toml overrides trusted runtime keys |
| $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/settings.json                   | settings.json applies saved model, profile, and context choices          |
| .env                                               | .env values override file-backed config                                  |
| environment                                        | Process environment overrides dotenv and files                           |
| cli flag                                           | Command-line flags override loaded config                                |
| gateway/tui runtime override                       | Gateway and TUI runtime overrides share CLI-level precedence             |
| $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/profiles/<profile>/profile.toml | Selected profile metadata applies after explicit selection               |
| derived                                            | Derived normalized values are recorded after model/provider defaults     |

## settings.json

This file uses `config.BillySettings` as the canonical JSON shape. It stores TUI display preferences plus the saved model/profile/context choices that config resolution reads from the settings layer.

| JSON key                       | Go field                  | Type    | Optional | Written by    |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------- |
| theme                          | Theme                     | string  | no       | tui           |
| tool_view                      | ToolView                  | string  | no       | tui           |
| think_view                     | ThinkView                 | string  | no       | tui           |
| transcript_mode                | TranscriptMode            | string  | no       | tui           |
| context_window_tokens          | ContextWindowTokens       | int64   | no       | tui           |
| context_compact_tokens         | ContextCompactTokens      | int     | yes      | manual/legacy |
| input_price_per_1m_tokens      | InputPricePer1MTokens     | float64 | no       | tui           |
| output_price_per_1m_tokens     | OutputPricePer1MTokens    | float64 | no       | tui           |
| cache_hit_price_per_1m_tokens  | CacheHitPricePer1MTokens  | float64 | no       | tui           |
| cache_miss_price_per_1m_tokens | CacheMissPricePer1MTokens | float64 | no       | tui           |
| last_local_chat_id             | LastLocalChatID           | string  | yes      | tui           |
| last_gateway_session_id        | LastGatewaySessionID      | string  | yes      | tui           |
| last_selected_model            | LastSelectedModel         | string  | yes      | tui           |
| last_profile                   | LastProfile               | string  | yes      | tui           |
| last_access_mode               | LastAccessMode            | string  | yes      | tui           |
| last_reasoning_effort          | LastReasoningEffort       | string  | yes      | tui           |
| last_reasoning_kind            | LastReasoningKind         | string  | yes      | tui           |

## Outside The Key Table

| Item                                       | Description                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| workspace_roots                            | Computed from the current working directory, not read from configSpecs()      |
| $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/mcp.config.toml         | MCP sub-registry loaded by $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/mcp.config.toml                 |
| $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/hooks.config.toml       | Hook sub-registry loaded by $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/hooks.config.toml              |
| $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/diagnostics.config.toml | Diagnostics sub-registry loaded by $BILLYHARNESS_HOME/diagnostics.config.toml |
